single.rationale: Ethan Allen faces persistent multi-year revenue declines (9.1% three-year CAGR) with accelerating margin compression - operating margin fell from 16.9% in FY2022 to 10.1% in FY2025 despite maintaining 75% vertical integration. While the company maintains reasonable valuation (11.9x P/E, 6.7% FCF yield) and decent cash generation, the structural headwinds in furniture retail combined with deteriorating profitability trends suggest limited near-term catalysts for outperformance.
